title: Solons eye Google Play, App Store restrictions on unregistered lending apps amid abusive debt collection
summary: As a House panel tackled bills against abusive debt collection practices, lawmakers discussed the possibility of requiring Google and Apple to enforce requirements for online lending platforms.
